data.description:
## Context
README workflow prose conflicts with current claim, graph, help, and close behavior. The dispatcher fix on `chartreuse-interested-viper`, the assignee correction on `weariless-scrapable-mouse`, the quickstart work on `tsunamic-wax-hog`, and ADR 0100 define the historical basis. F12 completed command discovery before this story finalized help wording.

## Plan
- Document default claim assignment and Jira-resolvable explicit overrides.
- Name all seven relations, including `caused_by`.
- Document optional relation-scoped unlink.
- Describe help recognition before `--` while preserving nested `bridge` and `audit` handling.
- Describe integrated completion verification for task, bug, story, and epic closes as an optional gate that is disabled by default and enabled with `verify.require_completion_verification_for_close`.
- Preserve the tested quickstart and existing README structure.
- Compare README wording against the behavior exercised by `tests/unit/test_claim_default_assignee.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_unlink_relation_scoped_e39f.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py`, and `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_completion_gate.py`.
- Leave demonstration assets for F16.

## Verification
- D1 runs `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`.
- D2 runs `python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py`.
- D3 runs `python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_check_readme_quickstart.py -q`.
- D4 runs `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_claim_default_assignee.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_unlink_relation_scoped_e39f.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_completion_gate.py -q`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Generic claim guidance omits an explicit assignee and explains valid overrides.
- [x] Link guidance names all seven relations.
- [x] Unlink guidance documents omitted and explicit relation behavior.
- [x] Help guidance matches leaf and nested command behavior.
- [x] Close guidance states that ordinary work-ticket completion verification is optional, disabled by default, and enabled with `verify.require_completion_verification_for_close`.
- [x] The recorded D1 through D4 verification commands pass.
- [x] No demonstration asset or unrelated README section changes.
data.title: F08A correct README workflow contracts
